title: Neo.mjs Skill Capability Manifest

oversizedWorkflowMaps.description: List of files that are historically oversized and locked against substantive positive growth.

maxPositiveDeltaBytes.description: Allowed net-positive bytes (for 1-line pointers) on oversized files. Typical pointer is ~150 bytes.

descriptionBudget.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte length of a SKILL.md frontmatter description (create-skill/references/skill-authoring-guide.md:83).

perFilePayloadBudget.description: Optional per-individual-file byte ceiling within references/. Defaults to disabled when omitted. Recursive Map vs World Atlas enforcement per #11314 / #11319 / #11320.

rareTriggerPatterns.description: Optional list of substrings that classify a section-trigger as rare-firing for lint heuristics.

budgetRationale.description: Required when a skill overrides a budget above defaults (e.g. descriptionBudget > defaults.descriptionBudget).

perFilePayloadBudget.description: Optional per-individual-file byte ceiling within references/. Overrides defaults.perFilePayloadBudget when set. Omit to disable per-file enforcement for this skill.

audiences.description: The audiences this skill serves, declared and never inferred. Omitted means maintainer, the audience every row served before the field existed. `neo-agent-skills-materialize --audience <name>` projects exactly the rows that list <name>.

relationships.description: Optional future-extension metadata. No v1 lint rules consume this field.

skill.description: A skill row. Only name and description are required: every budget field is an OVERRIDE of defaults, so a row that agrees with defaults omits them entirely. Restoring them as required would re-introduce the 148 default-equal repetitions this schema exists to forbid.

description: downstreamDocsTargets was removed 2026-08-26: it named neomjs/neo doc paths that do not exist in a consuming repository, so it could never be satisfied outside the authoring repo.
